ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the food web, what leads to an increase in the population of ants?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web, plant is located above, with an arrow pointing to ant on the left; below ant there is an arrow pointing to lizard. Directly related to the ant is the arrow from ant to lizard. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten to the predator, that is, the arrow points from the food to the animal that eats it. Therefore, ant to lizard means that the lizard eats the ant. If lizard dies or decreases, the number of ants being preyed on will decrease, so the ant population will increase. The answer is that the lizard dies.
